summary: Dashboard date-range filter feature tested end-to-end. Backend GET /api/dashboard/summary correctly returns default_today=true when no params, with period_* keys reflecting today (Rp 165.000) and total_*_all reflecting all-time (Rp 224.000). Full-range 2020-2030 makes period_revenue==total_revenue_all. Series/top_products correctly scoped to period. Backwards-compat aliases intact. Frontend Dashboard renders all 8 required summary-* data-testids with correct sub-labels ('HARI INI'/'SEPANJANG MASA'/'SEMUA WAKTU' etc.), dashboard-range selector works, Custom shows dashboard-start/dashboard-end date inputs, chart title includes range label, and switching to 'Semua Waktu' or Custom 2020-2030 makes period_revenue value equal total_revenue_all value. Kemarin correctly returns Rp 0 (no yesterday txns). Navigation regression OK.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard_summary stores date filter using string comparison on created_at (Mongo `$gte`/`$lte` against ISO strings). Works because created_at is stored as ISO string; still, timezone offsets in ISO can produce lexicographic surprises. Consider normalizing to UTC 'Z' before compare, or store as BSON Date.
server.py contains dead code: lines 943+ show an unreachable second `return { total_sales_today: ... }` block after the primary return in dashboard_summary. Harmless but should be cleaned up.

Frontend `custom` range's end date uses local-time `new Date(customEnd + 'T23:59:59').toISOString()` which shifts by TZ offset; for a user in UTC+7 an end date of 2025-01-31 becomes 2025-01-31T16:59:59Z. Acceptable but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing transactions in DB (today revenue Rp 165.000, all-time Rp 224.000).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_dashboard_range.py covers default_today, full-range equivalence, empty period, backwards-compat aliases, invalid date tolerance. Playwright verified selector data-testid=dashboard-range, dashboard-start, dashboard-end, and summary-{period_sales,period_revenue,period_transactions,period_net_profit,period_expense,total_product,total_stock,total_revenue_all}. Chart title 'Tren Penjualan & Laba — <range label>' verified.
